blocks.title: Reversible amal
blocks.text: Reversible amal woh hai jo mahol mein koi tabdeeli paida kiye baghair bilkul ulti tarteeb mein wapas chalaya ja sake. Ulte amal mein working substance unhi marhalon se guzarta hai jin se seedhe amal mein, magar har marhale par thermal aur mechanical asraat bilkul ulte hote hain: agar seedhe amal mein heat jazb ho to ulte amal mein di jati hai, aur agar seedhe amal mein madda kaam kare to ulte amal mein madde par kaam hota hai; is liye working substance apni asal halat par wapas aata hai.

blocks.title: Cycle aur reversible cycle
blocks.text: Waqeat ka aisa silsila jo system ko us ki ibtidai halat par wapas laye cycle kehlata hai. Reversible cycle woh hai jis mein sab tabdeeliyan reversible hon.

Agarche koi asal tabdeeli poori tarah reversible nahi, kisi madde ke liquefaction aur evaporation ke amal, aahista kiye jayein to, amalan reversible hain. Isi tarah cylinder mein gas ka aahista compression reversible amal hai, kyunke piston par dabao aahista ghata kar compression ko expansion mein badla ja sakta hai, amal ulat-te hue.

blocks.title: Irreversible amal
blocks.text: Agar koi amal qaboo karne wale amil ulat kar peechhe ki simt mein wapas na chalaya ja sake to woh irreversible amal hai. Sab tabdeeliyan jo achanak hon, ya jin mein raghrat ya conduction, convection ya radiation se energy ka dissipation shamil ho, irreversible hain. Bohat zyada irreversible amal ki misal dhamaka (explosion) hai.

blocks.prompt: Reversible aur irreversible amal mein farq karein (short question 6.5). Kya raghrat se paak cylinder mein gas ka aahista compression reversible hai, aur raghrat reversibility kyun kharab karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Reversible amal unhi halaton se har heat aur kaam ke tabadle ko ulat kar aur mahol mein koi nishan chhore baghair peechhe chalaya ja sakta hai; irreversible nahi, aur us mein har achanak tabdeeli aur raghrat ya dissipation wala har amal shamil hai. Aahista raghrat se paak compression amalan reversible hai, kyunke piston ka dabao aahista ghatana use ulat deta hai. Raghrat kaam ko aisi heat mein badalti hai jo wahi kaam wapas nahi ban sakti, to mahol badal jata hai.

items: Reversible: mahol mein koi tabdeeli ke baghair bilkul wapas chalaya ja sakta hai (aahista liquefaction, evaporation, aahista compression); cycle system ko ibtidai halat par wapas lata hai, reversible cycle mein sab tabdeeliyan reversible. Irreversible: achanak tabdeeliyan, raghrat, conduction, convection ya radiation se dissipation; dhamaka.
